aligned_read_bases.denominator: Count of aligned query bases in primary records.
aligned_read_bases.description: Primary mapped nucleotide bases represented by CIGAR M, =, or X. Excludes soft clips, insertions, and hard clips.
aligned_read_bases.label: Aligned primary-read bases

average_concordance.denominator: Sum of valid concordance values / count of valid concordance rows.
average_concordance.description: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the concordance column in genome_coverage.csv, ignoring nonnumeric and 'unknown' contig rows.
average_concordance.label: Average concordance

average_read_depth.denominator: Sum of coverage / number of eligible rows with numeric coverage.
average_read_depth.description: Arithmetic mean of numeric coverage values in genome_coverage.csv. Rows whose contig name contains 'unknown' are excluded.
average_read_depth.label: Average read depth

clipped_read_fraction.denominator: Soft-clipped primary reads / all mapped primary reads.
clipped_read_fraction.description: Fraction of primary mapped read alignments carrying one or more soft clips, counting each mapped primary record once.
clipped_read_fraction.label: Fraction of mapped reads clipped

deleted_reference_bases.denominator: Count of CIGAR D reference bases.
deleted_reference_bases.description: Reference-consuming deletions in primary alignments, from CIGAR D. A deletion is not automatically a sequencing or assembler error.
deleted_reference_bases.label: Mapped reference deletion bases

duplicates.denominator: Primary mapped records with SAM duplicate flag 0x400 / records examined (count, not a rate).
duplicates.description: Primary mapped alignments marked duplicate by SAM flag 0x400. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
duplicates.label: Primary duplicate alignments

exact_coverage_breadth_ge_1.denominator: Positive-depth bases / all consensus bases. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_breadth_ge_1.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. Count of consensus bases with exact depth at least 1, divided by total sequence length.
exact_coverage_breadth_ge_1.label: Exact read coverage
exact_coverage_breadth_ge_1.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_breadth_ge_10.denominator: Bases with depth ≥10 / all consensus bases. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_breadth_ge_10.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. Count of consensus bases with exact depth at least 10, divided by total sequence length.
exact_coverage_breadth_ge_10.label: Exact read coverage at ≥10
exact_coverage_breadth_ge_10.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_breadth_ge_100.denominator: Bases with depth ≥100 / all consensus bases. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_breadth_ge_100.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. Count of consensus bases with exact depth at least 100, divided by total sequence length.
exact_coverage_breadth_ge_100.label: Exact read coverage at ≥100
exact_coverage_breadth_ge_100.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_breadth_ge_3.denominator: Bases with depth ≥3 / all consensus bases. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_breadth_ge_3.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. Count of consensus bases with exact depth at least 3, divided by total sequence length.
exact_coverage_breadth_ge_3.label: Exact read coverage at ≥3
exact_coverage_breadth_ge_3.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_length.denominator: One sequence selected by length; no sum across final contigs. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_length.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. Number of bases in the selected longest final MAX consensus.
exact_coverage_length.label: Exact read sequence length
exact_coverage_length.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_longest_zero_run.denominator: A run ends when a base has positive depth; measured in bases. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_longest_zero_run.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. Length of the longest consecutive stretch of zero-depth bases along the selected consensus.
exact_coverage_longest_zero_run.label: Exact read longest zero-depth stretch
exact_coverage_longest_zero_run.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_maximum.denominator: All bases; multiple exact read placements contribute separately. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_maximum.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. Largest per-base exact depth over the selected consensus.
exact_coverage_maximum.label: Exact read maximum depth
exact_coverage_maximum.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_mean.denominator: All consensus bases, including those with zero exact matches. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_mean.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. Sum the exact-match read placement depth at every consensus base, then divide by sequence length.
exact_coverage_mean.label: Exact read mean depth
exact_coverage_mean.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_median.denominator: All bases in the selected consensus, including zeros. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_median.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. Median of exact depth values over all consensus bases; for an even number of bases, average the two central sorted depths.
exact_coverage_median.label: Exact read median depth
exact_coverage_median.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_minimum.denominator: All bases, including zeros; not the minimum among covered bases. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_minimum.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. Smallest per-base exact depth over the selected consensus.
exact_coverage_minimum.label: Exact read minimum depth
exact_coverage_minimum.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_1.denominator: Positive-depth bases / all consensus bases. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_1.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. Count of consensus bases with exact depth at least 1, divided by total sequence length.
exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_1.label: Exact interior read coverage
exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_1.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_10.denominator: Bases with depth ≥10 / all consensus bases. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_10.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. Count of consensus bases with exact depth at least 10, divided by total sequence length.
exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_10.label: Exact interior read coverage at ≥10
exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_10.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_100.denominator: Bases with depth ≥100 / all consensus bases. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_100.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. Count of consensus bases with exact depth at least 100, divided by total sequence length.
exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_100.label: Exact interior read coverage at ≥100
exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_100.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_3.denominator: Bases with depth ≥3 / all consensus bases. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_3.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. Count of consensus bases with exact depth at least 3, divided by total sequence length.
exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_3.label: Exact interior read coverage at ≥3
exact_coverage_overlapped_breadth_ge_3.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_length.denominator: One sequence selected by length; no sum across final contigs. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_length.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. Number of bases in the selected longest final MAX consensus.
exact_coverage_overlapped_length.label: Exact interior read sequence length
exact_coverage_overlapped_length.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_longest_zero_r.denominator: A run ends when a base has positive depth; measured in bases. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_longest_zero_r.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. Length of the longest consecutive stretch of zero-depth bases along the selected consensus.
exact_coverage_overlapped_longest_zero_r.label: Exact interior read longest zero-depth stretch
exact_coverage_overlapped_longest_zero_r.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_maximum.denominator: All bases; multiple exact read placements contribute separately. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_maximum.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. Largest per-base exact depth over the selected consensus.
exact_coverage_overlapped_maximum.label: Exact interior read maximum depth
exact_coverage_overlapped_maximum.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_mean.denominator: All consensus bases, including those with zero exact matches. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_mean.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. Sum the exact-match read placement depth at every consensus base, then divide by sequence length.
exact_coverage_overlapped_mean.label: Exact interior read mean depth
exact_coverage_overlapped_mean.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_median.denominator: All bases in the selected consensus, including zeros. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_median.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. Median of exact depth values over all consensus bases; for an even number of bases, average the two central sorted depths.
exact_coverage_overlapped_median.label: Exact interior read median depth
exact_coverage_overlapped_median.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_minimum.denominator: All bases, including zeros; not the minimum among covered bases. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_minimum.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. Smallest per-base exact depth over the selected consensus.
exact_coverage_overlapped_minimum.label: Exact interior read minimum depth
exact_coverage_overlapped_minimum.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_p10.denominator: All bases including zeros; nearest-index quantile, no interpolation. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_p10.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. 10th percentile of sorted per-base depths using index round((length − 1) × 0.10).
exact_coverage_overlapped_p10.label: Exact interior read 10th-percentile depth
exact_coverage_overlapped_p10.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_p25.denominator: All bases including zeros; nearest-index quantile, no interpolation. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_p25.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. 25th percentile of sorted per-base depths using index round((length − 1) × 0.25).
exact_coverage_overlapped_p25.label: Exact interior read 25th-percentile depth
exact_coverage_overlapped_p25.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_p50.denominator: All bases including zeros; nearest-index quantile, no interpolation. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_p50.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. 50th percentile of sorted per-base depths using index round((length − 1) × 0.50). This may differ from the median.
exact_coverage_overlapped_p50.label: Exact interior read 50th-percentile depth
exact_coverage_overlapped_p50.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_p75.denominator: All bases including zeros; nearest-index quantile, no interpolation. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_p75.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. 75th percentile of sorted per-base depths using index round((length − 1) × 0.75).
exact_coverage_overlapped_p75.label: Exact interior read 75th-percentile depth
exact_coverage_overlapped_p75.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_p90.denominator: All bases including zeros; nearest-index quantile, no interpolation. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_p90.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. 90th percentile of sorted per-base depths using index round((length − 1) × 0.90).
exact_coverage_overlapped_p90.label: Exact interior read 90th-percentile depth
exact_coverage_overlapped_p90.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_zero_count.denominator: Every base is evaluated, not only bases where reads map. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_zero_count.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. Count of consensus bases with exact-match depth equal to zero.
exact_coverage_overlapped_zero_count.label: Exact interior read zero-depth bases
exact_coverage_overlapped_zero_count.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_overlapped_zero_fraction.denominator: Zero-depth bases / all consensus bases, including uncovered ends. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_overlapped_zero_fraction.description: Interior: the same exact matching, but the 70 bases at each read end do not contribute to depth. Number of zero-depth consensus bases divided by sequence length.
exact_coverage_overlapped_zero_fraction.label: Exact interior read zero-depth fraction
exact_coverage_overlapped_zero_fraction.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_p10.denominator: All bases including zeros; nearest-index quantile, no interpolation. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_p10.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. 10th percentile of sorted per-base depths using index round((length − 1) × 0.10).
exact_coverage_p10.label: Exact read 10th-percentile depth
exact_coverage_p10.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_p25.denominator: All bases including zeros; nearest-index quantile, no interpolation. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_p25.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. 25th percentile of sorted per-base depths using index round((length − 1) × 0.25).
exact_coverage_p25.label: Exact read 25th-percentile depth
exact_coverage_p25.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_p50.denominator: All bases including zeros; nearest-index quantile, no interpolation. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_p50.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. 50th percentile of sorted per-base depths using index round((length − 1) × 0.50). This may differ from the median.
exact_coverage_p50.label: Exact read 50th-percentile depth
exact_coverage_p50.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_p75.denominator: All bases including zeros; nearest-index quantile, no interpolation. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_p75.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. 75th percentile of sorted per-base depths using index round((length − 1) × 0.75).
exact_coverage_p75.label: Exact read 75th-percentile depth
exact_coverage_p75.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_p90.denominator: All bases including zeros; nearest-index quantile, no interpolation. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_p90.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. 90th percentile of sorted per-base depths using index round((length − 1) × 0.90).
exact_coverage_p90.label: Exact read 90th-percentile depth
exact_coverage_p90.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_zero_count.denominator: Every base is evaluated, not only bases where reads map. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_zero_count.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. Count of consensus bases with exact-match depth equal to zero.
exact_coverage_zero_count.label: Exact read zero-depth bases
exact_coverage_zero_count.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_coverage_zero_fraction.denominator: Zero-depth bases / all consensus bases, including uncovered ends. These are read placements, not unique molecules or approximate SAM mappings.
exact_coverage_zero_fraction.description: Full read: exact no-substitution, no-indel matching of original R1/R2 reads to the longest final MiCall MAX sequence, across both orientations and every exact placement. Number of zero-depth consensus bases divided by sequence length.
exact_coverage_zero_fraction.label: Exact read zero-depth fraction
exact_coverage_zero_fraction.stage: Final MiCall consensus / exact paired-FASTQ read matching

exact_uncovered_bases.denominator: Eligible positions on the single longest represented contig, not summed across contigs.
exact_uncovered_bases.description: Count of exact_coverage.csv positions with exact_coverage = 0 on the contig having the most valid full-read coverage rows.
exact_uncovered_bases.label: Exact uncovered bases

exact_uncovered_fraction.denominator: Zero-depth full-read positions / valid positions on that contig.
exact_uncovered_fraction.description: Fraction of valid exact_coverage.csv positions with full-read exact_coverage = 0, on the longest represented contig.
exact_uncovered_fraction.label: Exact uncovered fraction

exact_uncovered_overlapped_bases.denominator: Eligible positions with numeric interior depth on that contig; interior matching excludes 70 read-end bases.
exact_uncovered_overlapped_bases.description: Count of positions with exact_coverage_overlapped = 0 for the same longest contig selected by full-read positions.
exact_uncovered_overlapped_bases.label: Exact uncovered overlapped bases

final_contig_31mer_redundancy_fraction.denominator: Valid 31-mer windows across nonempty contigs; repeated windows count repeatedly in the denominator.
final_contig_31mer_redundancy_fraction.description: One minus the number of distinct canonical A/C/G/T 31-mers divided by all valid 31-mer instances across final contig sequences. A reverse complement shares a canonical 31-mer.
final_contig_31mer_redundancy_fraction.label: Redundant contig 31-mer fraction

final_contig_count.denominator: Nonempty 'contig' or 'sequence' entries; missing/empty files do not contribute a fabricated zero.
final_contig_count.description: Count of nonempty sequence rows in contigs.csv, including duplicate and unknown-reference contigs.
final_contig_count.label: Final contig count

final_contig_exact_duplicates.denominator: Nonempty sequences; exact matches only, without reverse-complement normalization.
final_contig_exact_duplicates.description: Number of contigs.csv sequences identical to a previously observed sequence after uppercase normalization; the first copy is not counted.
final_contig_exact_duplicates.label: Final contig exact duplicates

final_contig_total_bases.denominator: Nonempty contig rows; not unique genome coverage.
final_contig_total_bases.description: Sum of lengths of all nonempty contig sequences in contigs.csv. Overlapping and repeated sequences each contribute their length.
final_contig_total_bases.label: Total contig bases

final_contig_unknown_count.denominator: All nonempty contig rows; status is based on ref, not sequence.
final_contig_unknown_count.description: Count of nonempty contigs.csv sequences whose ref field contains 'unknown' (case insensitive).
final_contig_unknown_count.label: Final contig unknown count

inserted_bases.denominator: Count of CIGAR I query bases.
inserted_bases.description: Nucleotide insertions in primary read alignments, from CIGAR I. True biological indels cannot be classified as errors from this alone.
inserted_bases.label: Mapped primary-read insertion bases

left_clip_events.denominator: Count of primary mapped alignments whose leftmost non-hard-clipped CIGAR operation is S.
left_clip_events.description: Primary mapped CIGAR soft clips at the left read end. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
left_clip_events.label: Left soft-clip events

left_clipped_bases.denominator: Sum of lengths of the left terminal S operations across primary mapped alignments.
left_clipped_bases.description: Query bases removed by left-end CIGAR S operations. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
left_clipped_bases.label: Left soft-clipped bases

mapped_fragments.denominator: The single remap-fragments entry; missing summary is unavailable.
mapped_fragments.description: Count from the remap-fragments row of remap_counts.csv. This counts mapped original QNAME pairs, not mapped SAM records.
mapped_fragments.label: Mapped fragments

mapq_unknown.denominator: Primary mapped records whose MAPQ field is 255 (unknown); secondary and supplementary are excluded.
mapq_unknown.description: Primary mapped SAM alignments with mapping quality 255. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
mapq_unknown.label: Primary reads with unknown MAPQ

mapq_zero.denominator: Count of mapped primary records with MAPQ 0.
mapq_zero.description: Mapped primary reads assigned MAPQ 0, which indicates no mapping confidence on the SAM scale.
mapq_zero.label: Primary reads with MAPQ 0

mean_known_mapq.denominator: Sum of known primary MAPQ / primary records with MAPQ != 255.
mean_known_mapq.description: Mean mapping quality among mapped primary alignment records with known MAPQ. SAM MAPQ 255 denotes unknown and is excluded.
mean_known_mapq.label: Mean known MAPQ

mean_soft_clip_event_length.denominator: Sum of all terminal CIGAR S operation lengths / number of those S operations; no events is unavailable.
mean_soft_clip_event_length.description: Mean number of clipped query bases per primary CIGAR S event. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
mean_soft_clip_event_length.label: Mean soft-clip event length

multimap_avg_depth_mean.denominator: Sum of valid avg_depth / number of positions with valid max and avg depth.
multimap_avg_depth_mean.description: Arithmetic mean of fractional avg_depth from valid multimap_depth.csv position rows.
multimap_avg_depth_mean.label: Multimap avg depth mean

multimap_avg_depth_total.denominator: All valid multimap_depth.csv rows; ambiguous placements contribute fractional rather than independent read counts.
multimap_avg_depth_total.description: Sum of fractional avg_depth in multimap_depth.csv at positions where both max_depth and avg_depth are valid.
multimap_avg_depth_total.label: Multimap avg depth total

multimap_capped_pairs.denominator: One remap-count entry or a warning-derived lower bound; two remapping passes may overlap.
multimap_capped_pairs.description: Mapped pairs reaching the Bowtie2 -k reporting limit, taken from remap_counts.csv when present. Otherwise the maximum count among per-pass warnings is used as a lower bound, not their sum.
multimap_capped_pairs.label: Multimap capped pairs

multimap_max_depth_mean.denominator: Sum of valid max_depth / number of positions with valid max and avg depth.
multimap_max_depth_mean.description: Arithmetic mean of max_depth from valid multimap_depth.csv position rows.
multimap_max_depth_mean.label: Multimap max depth mean

multimap_max_depth_total.denominator: All valid multimap_depth.csv position rows; no length normalization.
multimap_max_depth_total.description: Sum of max_depth from multimap_depth.csv for contig positions where both max_depth and avg_depth are valid.
multimap_max_depth_total.label: Multimap max depth total

multimap_oversized_pairs.denominator: One validated remap count entry; no entry means unavailable.
multimap_oversized_pairs.description: Number of pairs rejected by the SAM record-group size limit, from the multimap-oversized-pairs row of remap_counts.csv.
multimap_oversized_pairs.label: Multimap oversized pairs

nuc_q15_covered_fraction.denominator: Positive-depth Q15 seed/positions / all valid Q15 seed/positions.
nuc_q15_covered_fraction.description: Proportion of deduplicated Q15 nuc.csv seed/position entries whose maximum observed coverage is positive.
nuc_q15_covered_fraction.label: Q15 breadth

nuc_q15_mean_depth.denominator: Sum of deduplicated Q15 coverage / number of distinct valid (seed, position) entries, including zero-depth entries.
nuc_q15_mean_depth.description: For q-cutoff 15 nuc.csv rows, keep the greatest numeric coverage per (seed, refseq.nuc.pos), then average those retained depths.
nuc_q15_mean_depth.label: Mean Q15 depth

nuc_q15_positions_covered.denominator: All distinct valid Q15 seed/position entries.
nuc_q15_positions_covered.description: Count of distinct (seed, refseq.nuc.pos) entries with Q15 coverage greater than zero, after retaining maximum depth for duplicates.
nuc_q15_positions_covered.label: Nuc Q15 positions covered

nuc_q15_total_depth.denominator: All distinct valid Q15 seed/position entries; not normalized.
nuc_q15_total_depth.description: Sum of greatest Q15 nuc.csv coverage per (seed, refseq.nuc.pos); overlapping region rows at the same seed/position count once.
nuc_q15_total_depth.label: Nuc Q15 total depth

nuc_soft_clips_count.denominator: Sum of max(clip) over distinct valid seed/reference positions.
nuc_soft_clips_count.description: For each (seed, refseq.nuc.pos) in nuc.csv, take the maximum nonnegative integer clip count across overlapping region rows, then sum these maxima. This is not the SAM CIGAR S event count.
nuc_soft_clips_count.label: MiCall per-position clip aggregate

primary_mapped.denominator: Count of primary mapped alignment records.
primary_mapped.description: Primary alignment records marked mapped in the SAM. Secondary and supplementary records are excluded; records need not be unique molecules.
primary_mapped.label: Primary mapped reads

primary_mapped_fraction.description: Fraction of primary SAM alignment records marked mapped; this is a read-record rate, not a genome reconstruction score.
primary_mapped_fraction.label: Primary mapped read fraction

primary_unmapped.denominator: Count of primary unmapped alignment records.
primary_unmapped.description: Primary alignment records carrying the SAM unmapped flag. Not the same as a count of unmatched original read pairs.
primary_unmapped.label: Primary unmapped reads

read_bases.denominator: Sum of SEQ lengths in primary mapped SAM records; bases include those subsequently soft-clipped.
read_bases.description: Query sequence bases in primary mapped SAM alignments. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
read_bases.label: Primary mapped sequenced bases

records.denominator: Number of SAM non-header records, including mapped, unmapped, secondary and supplementary alignments.
records.description: All mapped, unmapped, secondary and supplementary SAM records. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
records.label: SAM alignment records

reference_bases_ge_100.denominator: Eligible position rows, not the length of a common reference genome.
reference_bases_ge_100.description: Count of genome_coverage.csv positions with numeric coverage at least 100 after excluding 'unknown' contigs.
reference_bases_ge_100.label: Reference bases ge 100

region_concordance_covered_mean.denominator: Valid concordance rows with positive pct_covered; no weighting by region length or coverage.
region_concordance_covered_mean.description: Unweighted mean of numeric concordance.csv pct_concordance only where pct_covered is also numeric and greater than zero.
region_concordance_covered_mean.label: Region concordance covered mean

region_concordance_mean.denominator: Sum of valid pct_concordance / count of valid concordance rows; zero-coverage rows are included when they have numeric concordance.
region_concordance_mean.description: Unweighted mean of numeric pct_concordance in concordance.csv; rows without valid concordance are ignored.
region_concordance_mean.label: Mean region concordance

right_clip_events.denominator: Count of primary mapped alignments whose rightmost non-hard-clipped CIGAR operation is S.
right_clip_events.description: Primary mapped CIGAR soft clips at the right read end. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
right_clip_events.label: Right soft-clip events

right_clipped_bases.denominator: Sum of lengths of the right terminal S operations across primary mapped alignments.
right_clipped_bases.description: Query bases removed by right-end CIGAR S operations. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
right_clipped_bases.label: Right soft-clipped bases

secondary.denominator: Count of SAM secondary alignment records.
secondary.description: SAM secondary alignments, including alternative placements. A large count can reflect legitimate multi-mapping rather than errors.
secondary.label: Secondary alignments

soft_clip_events.denominator: Count; per 1,000 mapped primary reads is available separately.
soft_clip_events.description: CIGAR S operations on primary mapped reads. One read can contribute a left and right clip event.
soft_clip_events.label: Soft-clip events

soft_clip_events_per_1000_primary_mapped.description: Frequency of individual left/right CIGAR S clipping operations among mapped primary alignment records.
soft_clip_events_per_1000_primary_mapped.label: Clip events per 1,000 mapped reads

soft_clip_length_max.denominator: Maximum single CIGAR S operation length across primary mapped alignments; no clips yields zero.
soft_clip_length_max.description: Maximum CIGAR S operation length on primary mapped reads. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
soft_clip_length_max.label: Longest soft-clip event

soft_clipped_bases.denominator: Count; normalized per 1,000 mapped sequenced bases separately.
soft_clipped_bases.description: Total nucleotide bases excluded by CIGAR S operations on primary mapped alignment records.
soft_clipped_bases.label: Soft-clipped bases

soft_clipped_bases_per_1000_read_bases.description: Total soft-clipped nucleotides normalized by mapped primary-read sequence bases. A shorter clipped fraction is not necessarily biologically more accurate.
soft_clipped_bases_per_1000_read_bases.label: Clipped bases per 1,000 mapped read bases

soft_clipped_reads.denominator: Count; mapped primary alignment records are the reference population.
soft_clipped_reads.description: Primary mapped alignment records with at least one CIGAR S operation. Both ends of the same read count once here.
soft_clipped_reads.label: Soft-clipped primary reads

stitched_contig_count.denominator: Nonempty contig rows in this specific intermediate MiCall file.
stitched_contig_count.description: Number of rows with a nonempty contig field in stitched_contigs.csv.
stitched_contig_count.label: Stitched contig count

supplementary.denominator: Count of SAM supplementary alignment records.
supplementary.description: SAM supplementary alignments, often associated with split mappings. Whether more or fewer is desirable depends on the sample.
supplementary.label: Supplementary alignments

total_read_depth.denominator: All eligible numeric genome_coverage.csv coverage rows; not normalized by contig span.
total_read_depth.description: Sum of numeric coverage values across genome_coverage.csv rows, excluding rows with an 'unknown' contig.
total_read_depth.label: Total read depth

unique_aligned_fragments.denominator: One validated summary row; counts distinct original fragments, not placements.
unique_aligned_fragments.description: The unique_aligned_fragments field from the single summary row in unique_aligned_fragments.csv: original pairs with accepted Q15 placement.
unique_aligned_fragments.label: Unique aligned fragments

unstitched_contig_count.denominator: Nonempty contig rows in this specific intermediate MiCall file.
unstitched_contig_count.description: Number of rows with a nonempty contig field in unstitched_contigs.csv.
unstitched_contig_count.label: Unstitched contig count

note: No complete seven-arm mapping sample; individual verified diagnostics are in the current runs.
